task_items: package.json, JSON file, /var/www/project, opened with Visual Studio Code, lists project dependencies and their versions
yarn.lock, lock file, /var/www/project, opened with Sublime Text, stores exact versions of installed dependencies
Dockerfile, text file, /var/www/project, opened with WebStorm, contains instructions to define project environment and dependencies
npm, application, manages and installs Node.js project dependencies
Yarn, application, manages and installs project dependencies with alternative package resolution
npm audit, website, analyzes project dependencies for security vulnerabilities
npm update, command, executed in terminal, upgrades dependencies to latest compatible versions
yarn upgrade, command, executed in terminal, updates dependencies to their latest versions
npm outdated, command, executed in terminal, lists dependencies that are outdated
dashboardConfig.json, JSON file, /config, opened with VSCode, stores configuration settings for dashboard layout and metrics display
metrics.js, JavaScript file, /src/utils, opened with VSCode, contains functions to collect and process application metrics
dashboard.html, HTML file, /src/pages, opened with VSCode, defines the structure and layout of a web page
Grafana, application, /tools, provides tools for building and visualizing dashboards from metrics data
Datadog, application, /tools, monitors and visualizes performance and health metrics of applications
git commit -m 'Add real-time dashboard for app metrics', command, executed in terminal, records changes to the local repository
npm run start-dashboard, command, executed in terminal, starts a local development server
curl -X GET http://api.example.com/metrics, command, executed in terminal, sends HTTP requests and displays server responses
global_task_intention: Monitor and visualize application performance metrics
